title: Typography / presentation titles
slide_intent: Build a clear title hierarchy so a reader recognizes the subject before secondary details.
strategic_value: A consistent title system can connect DB presentations across light and dark backgrounds.
demonstration: A dark portrait title uses white text and a lilac gate graphic; a white landscape title uses black text and a red Schwelle.
practical_value: Compare title placement and supporting graphics across presentation orientations.

content_islands.name: Portrait title
content_islands.spec: Place the white two-line title beneath the red mark and above the gate illustration.

content_islands.name: Landscape title
content_islands.spec: Place the black title and subtitle centrally within a white slide framed by mark and Schwelle.

reference_purposes.Application: The pair demonstrates title hierarchy in two presentation formats.
